body:
Do you want a modded survival smp for content making?
Well come visit the dacreate smp. Made with content creation in mind.
### **Support**
If you have any queastions or suggestions, then email me or a staff member at dacreatesmp@outlook.com
### **why you should play**
You should join because you or a friend can play, make content, or just have fun. This is one of the only public content making servers so if your just starting your channel or can't use discord **you** can still play this server. This server also has flashback and I spent hours getting that to work because it is one of the best recording mod.
### **_Other recording stuff_**
If you don't have a recording sofware use this link to get a good recording sofware https://obsproject.com/
## _**Gamemodes**_
It's only survival and a recording server that can be used for intros thumbnails and other stuff like schematic stuff.
